findings.name: stock-db
findings.root_cause: stock-db is OOM-killed at its 24Mi memory limit, so stock-api cannot connect and crash-loops
findings.fix: raise the stock-db memory limit

findings.name: billing
findings.root_cause: a referenced ConfigMap does not exist
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: orders-api
findings.root_cause: orders-api exits at start-up with 'FATAL: DATABASE_URL is not set', so its pod crash-loops
findings.fix: set DATABASE_URL in the orders-api Deployment's environment

findings.name: mailer
findings.root_cause: mailer's dnsConfig points at nameserver 10.96.0.99, which does not answer, so smtp-relay does not resolve
findings.fix: remove mailer's custom dnsConfig and use dnsPolicy ClusterFirst

findings.name: thumbnailer
findings.root_cause: a sidecar fills ephemeral storage past its limit and kubelet evicts the pod
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

dx-healthy.summary: No failing workloads, events or endpoints found.

findings.name: frontend
findings.root_cause: the image or tag cannot be pulled
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: accounts-api
findings.root_cause: an init container waits for a service name that does not exist
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: nightly-export
findings.root_cause: the job's pods fail and it exhausted its retries
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: defaults
findings.root_cause: LimitRange defaults injects a 32Mi default memory limit into statement-builder, which is then OOM-killed
findings.fix: raise the LimitRange default memory limit, or give statement-builder an explicit limit

findings.name: ledger
findings.root_cause: the container exits at start-up with an application error (see log)
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: ledger-api
findings.root_cause: the service selector matches no pods, so it has no endpoints
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: checkout
findings.root_cause: Service checkout selects app=checkout-v2 but its pods are labelled app=checkout, so it has no endpoints
findings.fix: change the checkout Service selector to app: checkout

findings.name: report-worker
findings.root_cause: report-worker is OOM-killed: it uses more memory than its 32Mi limit
findings.fix: raise the report-worker memory limit (and request) above its working set

findings.name: cache
findings.root_cause: the pod's node selector matches no node
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: ml-trainer
findings.root_cause: no node has enough of the requested resources
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: pricing-api
findings.root_cause: Service pricing-api sends port 80 to targetPort 8080, but the nginx container listens on port 80, so connections are refused
findings.fix: set the pricing-api Service targetPort to 80

findings.name: web
findings.root_cause: web's readiness probe checks port 8081 but nginx listens on 80, so the pod never becomes ready
findings.fix: point the web readiness probe at port 80

findings.name: team-quota
findings.root_cause: ResourceQuota team-quota is used up, so the renderer ReplicaSet cannot create replicas 3-5
findings.fix: raise team-quota or lower renderer's requests

findings.name: reporting-api
findings.root_cause: requests are far above observed usage
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: catalog
findings.root_cause: the new ReplicaSet cannot become ready, so the rollout stalled on the old version
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: search-web
findings.root_cause: a tiny CPU limit makes the liveness probe time out, so kubelet restarts a healthy app
findings.fix: see root cause; change this object's spec or config

findings.name: auth-api
findings.root_cause: the upstream serving certificate has expired, so auth-api fails TLS verification
findings.fix: renew the expired serving certificate

findings.name: checkout-web
findings.root_cause: checkout-web verifies payments-api with a CA bundle that did not issue its certificate, so TLS verification fails
findings.fix: mount the CA that issued the payments-api certificate
